text: Evaluate the actions which could be taken in your country to improve the welfare of disadvantaged
people. [30]
‘Prison is ineffective in deterring criminal activity and rehabilitating offenders.’ Examine the possible
alternatives to prison sentences. [30]
‘The joy of sport is in taking part, rather than watching.’ To what extent do you agree?
‘Not enough is being done to tackle the problems of waste disposal.’ To what extent is this the case
in your country? [30]
‘The overuse of antibiotics has made them less effective.’ To what extent is this a serious threat to
health?
Assess whether or not mobile phones have improved human communication. [30]
To what extent should television and radio be independent of government control in your country?
‘Monsters in films, fairy tales and books force us to imagine the worst about ourselves.’ Evaluate
this statement with reference to at least two examples. [30]
‘It is important for cultures to preserve their traditional beliefs and customs.’ To what extent do you
agree? [30]
‘Free medical care is a fundamental right of all citizens in every country.’ To what extent do you
agree? [30]
